_about: Phase 7A controlled extraction probes, written and committed before any was run. Fictional names from the Phase 4 world. Each proposition is expressed several ways; 'expect' is what a correct extractor within rules:v2's contract should produce (type, roles, time kind), or null where nothing should be extracted from that message alone. 'variation' names what differs from the supported phrasing. Messages are said on 2025-08-20 by author 'Ivo Marsh' unless noted; 'context' gives earlier messages in the same thread.
